subject: CAIQ assertion reconciliation & audit liaison
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@blueharbor.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ response follow-ups

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the CAIQ package you sent last week. We're running through the responses as part of our pre-audit checks and have a few clarifying asks before the formal audit window the week of June 29. High-level: we need explicit evidence or guidance for the following assertions (examples): CSA-AC-01 (access control configuration snapshots), CSA-LOG-07 (retention and sampling of inference telemetry), CSA-KEY-03 (keystore rotation and KMS policy), and a mapping for any compensating controls you relied on.

Can you confirm:
- Which of the above assertions have bundled artifacts vs. operational narratives?
- Whether you can provide sanitized log samples for LOG-07 for the month of May (redacted PII).
- If we can be provisioned an auditor service account or a shared read-only S3/Drive link to fetch artifacts.

Timing: our auditors would like access by COB Wednesday (2026-06-24) so they can prepare the checklist ahead of the on-site/remote review. Is that feasible?

Appreciate a one-page mapping table that points to artifact names or paths we can pull.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
BlueHarbor Audit Team
liam.oconnor@blueharbor.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@blueharbor.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ response follow-ups

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick summary of next steps from our side:

- Attached: preliminary CAIQ_Response_v1.3.pdf (annotated assertions) and control_index_20260623.xlsx (single-sheet map with artifact names). Those map each CSA control to either: a) static artifact (e.g., key rotation policy doc, config snapshot), b) runtime evidence (redacted logs, telemetry extract), or c) operational narrative + owner attestation.
- We can provide a sanitized sample of telemetry for LOG-07 (May) and the keystore rotation report for KEY-03.
- We'll provision a read-only audit folder in Google Drive and mirror artifacts to a pre-auth S3 bucket if the auditors prefer. Proposed portal user: audits+blueharbor@redwood.com — let me know if that works.

Internal notes: looping in Marissa (evidence packaging) and Jordan (runtime/keystore owner) to finalize links and confirm scrubbed samples. Marissa/Jordan — see internal ask below and confirm timelines.

Liam — can you confirm the scope (full CAIQ or scoped controls) and whether the auditors need DocuSign attestation for any assertion? If not, we'll provide owner-signed attestations as PDFs.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Trust & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Attachments: CAIQ_Response_v1.3.pdf; control_index_20260623.xlsx

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-22T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Evidence packaging for BlueHarbor audit (LOG-07, KEY-03, AC-01)

Marissa / Jordan — brief runbook for the package Liam requested (deadline: 2026-06-24 COB):

1) control_index_20260623.xlsx — I filled the first pass mapping (sheet 'map'). Jordan: please confirm the control-owner column and add exact artifact filenames.
2) LOG-07 (telemetry): Marissa to prepare a redacted sample (May 2026) with the following:
   - 48-hour sample (UTC) focused on inference request/response metadata (no prompt content),
   - fields to include: timestamp, model_id, route_id, token_count, response_time_ms, request_id, tenant_id (hashed),
   - scrub all user-generated text and replace tenant_id with hashed identifier.
3) KEY-03 (keystore): Jordan to provide:
   - rotation ledger export (last 12 months),
   - KMS policy snapshot (ARNs redacted as needed),
   - two screenshots showing key versioning in KMS console (timestamped).
4) AC-01 (access control): Marissa to attach latest IAM config snapshot and one example of a role-to-policy mapping used for service accounts.
5) Evidence escrow: we'll create CAIQ-Response-and-escrow.zip and upload to folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3ExampleLink.
6) Attestations: I'll collect owner-signed PDFs (simple statement + timestamp). No DocuSign unless BlueHarbor explicitly requests it.

Notes on sanitization: prioritize removing prompts and user PII. Keep enough telemetry fields for reproducibility checks. If anything cannot be provided (e.g., raw prompt content), mark as 'operational narrative' in the index with expected remedial steps.

Please flag any blockers by EOD today.

-Steph

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@blueharbor.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-23T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ response follow-ups — evidence bundle and audit access

Hi Liam — following up with the packaged artifacts. We've compiled the requested materials and uploaded them to a read-only audit folder. Quick summary of what you can find:

- CAIQ_Response_v1.3.pdf: annotated CAIQ answers, control rationales, and compensating control notes.
- control_index_20260623.xlsx: index map with artifact filenames, responsible owners, and redaction notes.
- CAIQ-Response-and-escrow.zip: zip of artifacts (redacted telemetry sample for LOG-07, keystore rotation ledger, IAM snapshots, owner-signed attestations).

Access: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3ExampleLink (read-only). We also mirrored the zip to the pre-auth S3 mirror for auditor download if you prefer: s3://redwood-audit-mirror/blueharbor/BR-4432/CAIQ-20260623.zip.

Portal provisioning: we've created the audit account audits+blueharbor@redwood.com with read-only access to the audit folder. If you want the auditor to use an alternate email, tell us and we'll swap.

Open items: please confirm whether DocuSign attestations are required. Also confirm which controls remain in-scope for your review; we'll prioritize uploads where needed.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow morning (2026-06-24) to run through the control_index sheet and sample artifacts.

Thanks — let me know when you confirm access.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Attachments: CAIQ-Response-and-escrow.zip; control_index_20260623.xlsx
